why: Modern loft behind floor-to-ceiling steel-framed panoramic glazing, with a slow lateral camera slide that gives parallax between the glass panes and the room, and golden-hour reflections on the glass. It reads as premium architectural glazing, with no people, logos or text. Graded from its teal stock look into the build family: glass desaturated to warm slate, amber highlights, cream walls matching the ivory/brass palette, soft vignette; mean luma 85 vs 83 on build.webp. Loop: source frames 10-235 played as an eased ping-pong (cosine time remap, speed falls to zero at both turnarounds), 216 frames = 9.01 s at 23.976 fps. The clip has no independent motion, so the reversal is invisible. Seam diff 1.56 vs a median frame step of 1.33. Poster = video frame 0, so nothing jumps when playback starts
